name: Talon Karrde
knownLocation: Mobile; last confirmed aboard Wild Karrde
strategicImportance: Controls one of the most disciplined private intelligence networks operating outside New Republic and Imperial channels.
psychologicalNotes: Negotiates from patience. Prefers leverage that keeps future routes open. Shows unusual loyalty when loyalty produces long-term informational advantage.
operationalSummary: Karrde's value is not fleet strength, territory, or public influence. His strength is source discipline and the ability to know which fact matters before rival services know it exists.
quote: Information is not useful because it is secret. It is useful because it is accurate.

name: Mara Jade
strategicImportance: Former Imperial Hand with access patterns and operational instincts unavailable to conventional smugglers.
lastConfirmedActivity: 09 ABY, coordination with New Republic contact channels
psychologicalNotes: Hostility toward Skywalker remains tactically real but strategically altered. Subject responds poorly to manipulation and better to mission clarity.
operationalSummary: Jade is the network's sharpest field instrument. She is not merely an enforcer; she reads political and tactical pressure before most commanders read orders.
quote: Some debts are tactical. Some become structural.

name: Grand Admiral Thrawn
currentStatus: Deceased; confirmation accepted with narrow caveats
knownLocation: Last confirmed aboard Chimaera near Bilbringi
strategicImportance: The only Imperial commander in this period capable of converting limited materiel into theater-scale initiative.
psychologicalNotes: Demonstrates extraordinary strategic pattern recognition. Consistently exploits overlooked variables. Political ambitions appear secondary to restoration of Imperial stability.
operationalSummary: Avoid direct military engagement when possible. Deny artwork, source material, shipping irregularities, and cultural signals. Thrawn's battlefield is never only the battlefield.
quote: The smallest neglected variable often becomes the campaign.

name: Luke Skywalker
knownLocation: Variable; New Republic and Jedi-related travel
strategicImportance: High symbolic value. Operational effect exceeds rank, authority, and available assets.
psychologicalNotes: Persistent optimism is not naivete. Subject repeatedly creates negotiation channels in environments where no channel should survive.
operationalSummary: Skywalker changes the decision math around him. Treat encounters as political, psychological, and tactical events simultaneously.
quote: A Jedi is rarely just a Jedi.

name: Leia Organa Solo
strategicImportance: Central legitimizing figure for New Republic policy and Noghri realignment.
psychologicalNotes: Maintains composure under direct personal threat. Diplomatic pressure increases rather than reduces operational clarity.
operationalSummary: Organa Solo remains the New Republic's best bridge between legitimacy, intelligence, and moral authority.
quote: Diplomacy is not softer than force. It is simply harder to measure.

name: Gilad Pellaeon
strategicImportance: Continuity figure for Imperial naval doctrine after command disruption.
psychologicalNotes: Professional, conservative, observant. More dangerous as an institutional memory than as an innovator.
operationalSummary: Pellaeon preserves what survives. Track him for evidence of Imperial consolidation after charismatic command failure.
quote: The retreat tells the next campaign where to begin.

name: Han Solo
knownLocation: Variable; New Republic special liaison routes
strategicImportance: Moves between formal New Republic authority and fringe credibility with unusual ease.
lastConfirmedActivity: 09 ABY, post-Nkllon and Noghri contact routes
psychologicalNotes: Resists formal process but often delivers outcomes formal process cannot reach. Threat response improves when the stakes become personal.
operationalSummary: Solo remains one of the few New Republic figures independent operators will hear without assuming immediate absorption into government channels.
quote: Some people call it improvisation when they missed the preparation.

name: Lando Calrissian
knownLocation: Nkllon industrial operations and variable commercial routes
strategicImportance: Commercial instincts expose military risks hidden inside supply-chain language.
psychologicalNotes: Uses charm as camouflage for careful risk arithmetic. More disciplined than casual observers assume.
operationalSummary: Calrissian is a useful bridge between capital, logistics, and covert access. Treat his enterprises as early-warning sensors.
quote: Profit and survival are not always separate ledgers.

name: Aves
strategicImportance: Operational continuity figure inside Karrde's distributed network.
psychologicalNotes: Practical, direct, and more comfortable with logistics than politics. Valuable because he keeps fragile systems ordinary.
operationalSummary: Aves is the kind of lieutenant a private intelligence service survives on: unglamorous, informed, and difficult to replace quietly.
quote: The route works because someone boring kept it that way.

name: Ghent
strategicImportance: Exceptional technical access potential with limited political self-protection.
psychologicalNotes: Technically fearless and socially under-armored. Requires shielding from coercive recruitment and praise-based manipulation.
operationalSummary: Ghent turns locked channels into usable evidence. His value rises whenever a faction believes encryption can substitute for operational discipline.
quote: A locked door is still a statement about what someone fears.

name: Niles Ferrier
strategicImportance: Can move military hardware across ownership boundaries faster than formal registries can respond.
psychologicalNotes: Greed is predictable; vanity is exploitable. Avoid deals that allow him to define proof of delivery.
operationalSummary: Ferrier is not a grand strategist, which makes him useful to grand strategists. Watch him for the assets powerful actors cannot move openly.
quote: A thief with good timing is an intelligence indicator.

name: Joruus C'baoth
occupation: Dark Jedi and coercive force actor
strategicImportance: Force capability paired with instability created unacceptable command-contamination risk.
psychologicalNotes: Possessive, grandiose, and structurally unsuited to subordination. Cooperation with Imperial command was always temporary.
operationalSummary: C'baoth was less an asset than a weaponized liability. His presence made every Thrawn plan involving Jedi variables more brittle.
quote: Power without discipline contaminates every command channel it touches.

name: Borsk Fey'lya
strategicImportance: Political friction generator inside New Republic decision cycles.
psychologicalNotes: Ambition is not incidental. Subject treats information as position before treating it as truth.
operationalSummary: Fey'lya rarely changes military outcomes directly, but he changes how quickly others are allowed to respond to them.
quote: A delay can be a weapon if nobody records who benefited.

name: Wedge Antilles
strategicImportance: Translates small-unit initiative into fleet-level survival with unusual consistency.
psychologicalNotes: Low theatrical profile. High operational clarity. Treat calm estimates as compressed experience, not caution.
operationalSummary: Antilles is one of the New Republic's most reliable indicators of whether a plan survives contact with competent pilots.
quote: Pilots find the lie in a plan before committees finish naming it.

name: Mon Mothma
strategicImportance: Stabilizes legitimacy while military and intelligence services absorb campaign shocks.
psychologicalNotes: Prefers institutional durability over dramatic movement. Vulnerable to timing pressure, not panic.
operationalSummary: Mothma's value is continuity. Her approval turns urgent response into legitimate action, but the process creates exploitable delay.
quote: A government survives by making victory governable.

name: Garm Bel Iblis
strategicImportance: Adds capable independent military weight while testing New Republic command cohesion.
psychologicalNotes: Strategic pride remains real. Cooperation improves when autonomy is acknowledged rather than erased.
operationalSummary: Bel Iblis represents the best and worst of independent command: fast judgment, high competence, and a standing question about integration.
quote: A friendly fleet can still be a command problem.

name: Winter Celchu
strategicImportance: Provides high-fidelity recall and quiet authentication support near senior political principals.
psychologicalNotes: Low signature and high retention. Subject is most useful when nobody notices she has become the record.
operationalSummary: Winter turns conversation, timing, and political room movement into retrievable intelligence.
quote: The best archive in the room may look like an aide.

name: Rukh
politicalAlignment: Noghri loyalty realigned after Imperial deception exposure
strategicImportance: The final proof that Imperial control of Noghri loyalty had become fatally brittle.
psychologicalNotes: Personal obedience gave way to collective truth. The shift was quiet until it was irreversible.
operationalSummary: Rukh's action converted a diplomatic disclosure on Honoghr into a theater-scale military outcome.
quote: A bodyguard becomes a strategic variable when loyalty changes owners.

name: Khabarakh
strategicImportance: Enabled the first durable breach in Imperial narrative control over Honoghr.
psychologicalNotes: Risk tolerance increased when personal observation contradicted inherited Imperial claims.
operationalSummary: Khabarakh is less important as an individual source than as proof that the Noghri information boundary can be crossed.
quote: One uncertain contact can move an entire clan ledger.
